# freshdesk_solution_folder (Resource)

A knowledge-base folder, which holds articles inside a category.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `category_id` (Number) ID of the parent category. Changing it forces a new folder, because Freshdesk cannot move a folder between categories.
- `name` (String) Name of the folder.

### Optional

- `company_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the companies that may read the folder. Only used when `visibility` is `4`.
- `description` (String) Description of the folder.
- `parent_folder_id` (Number) ID of the parent folder, making this one a subfolder.
- `visibility` (Number) Who may read the folder: `1` all users, `2` logged-in users, `3` agents, `4` selected companies, `5` bots.

### Read-Only

- `articles_count` (Number) Number of articles in the folder.
- `created_at` (String) When the folder was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the folder.
- `updated_at` (String) When the folder was last changed (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by numeric ID.
terraform import freshdesk_solution_folder.example 42
```
